correctness.rationale: The original RESULT.md gives the necessary/sufficient block form f(v+tz)=Av+(ell(v)+ct)z with omega(Ax,Ay)=c omega(x,y). For c!=0, A is a symplectic similitude, giving q^{2m}(q-1)|Sp_{2m}(q)| full-rank maps. For c=0, im A totally isotropic of dimension r<=m: count isotropic r-spaces via frames, surjections V->W via product_{i<r}(q^{2m}-q^i), and ell in the row space (q^r choices) versus outside (q^{2m}-q^r). This reconstructs each N_{m,k} including rank zero and characteristic two. The ratio B_{m,m-1}/B_{m,m}=q^{-m}/(q^2-1)+o(q^{-m}) and rank loss from ell gives the coefficient q^2/(q^2-1); symplectic maps negligible. Independent direct finite-field matrix counts match (m,q)=(1,2),(1,3),(2,2) with respective rank vectors (1,21,18,24), (1,104,192,432), (1,465,15750,37800,0,11520). The matrix enumeration supports only tested finite cases; asymptotic follows from ratios.
